title: KPM Record
description: One per-UE telemetry record. Written as JSONL by the KPM xApp (live) or the twin (simulated). Frozen per issue #1 — changing this schema requires sign-off from both George and Raneem.

ue_id.description: Stable UE identifier within the emitting stack (e.g. RNTI or IMSI-derived label).

serving_cell_id.description: Serving cell identifier (NCI or short cell label; same convention live and twin).

rsrp_dbm.description: SS-RSRP in dBm (3GPP range). Under NSA field data this is the LTE anchor RSRP — label in provenance docs, not here.

throughput_mbps.description: DL throughput in Mbps over the reporting window, if available.

neighbors.description: Neighbor measurements in the same window (empty if not reported).

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the measurement window end.
